gap: No result ChatGPT got gives today's prices. Rivals list only launch prices (Creality K2 Plus $1,299, Anycubic Kobra S1 Max $899) or, in ChatGPT's own cards, older ones (K2 Plus $999). None works out cost per litre. At maker-store prices on 2026-11-14, the 42.9 L Kobra S1 Max ($699, about $16.3/L) and K2 Plus ($899, about $21.0/L) cost the same as or less than the 30.7 L QIDI Plus5 ($699) and the 51.7 L QIDI Max4 ($1,049). The Prusa CORE One L+ works out to about $62/L.
standout_why: I compared against three pages. desktop3dprinters.us/lists/large-enclosed-3d-printers (cited, verified 2026-10-30) gives launch prices only. Its own text says it 'makes no statement on' price per litre or cost per build volume, and it doesn't tie most prices to a source. desktop3dprinters.us/lists/chamber-temperature-specs (cited) also gives launch prices only: K2 Plus $1,299, Kobra S1 Max $899, Max4 $1,149, Plus5 $749, CORE One L+ $1,999. The cited creativebloq page body didn't load, so I couldn't compare against it. ChatGPT's answer leaves out the Kobra S1 Max, though rival result #1 lists it. ChatGPT also showed the K2 Plus at $999, but the Creality US store shows $899 today.
decides: For 'large enclosed with an actively heated chamber' on a budget, today's prices change the value pick. The Kobra S1 Max ($699, 350 × 350 × 350 mm, 65 °C chamber per desktop3dprinters) costs the same as ChatGPT's 'best value' QIDI Plus5 but holds 12.2 L more. The K2 Plus ($899) costs $200 more than ChatGPT's value pick and holds 12.2 L more. The QIDI Max4 is still the largest heated option under $1,100 at $1,049. That is $50 below the Best Buy price ChatGPT showed, and it's on Dealectric's awin:qidi program. The Prusa CORE One L+ costs about three times as much per litre as the other picks. I couldn't price the Bambu H2S today, so I can't confirm or overturn its 'best overall' rank on price.

findings.label: Price, QIDI US store
findings.note: Read with storecheck.py search on qidi3d.com. ChatGPT's card showed $1,099 at Best Buy. Dealectric lists this model as qidi-max4 (awin:qidi).

findings.label: Build volume and cost per litre
findings.note: The store text states 'Build volume 390x390x340 mm'. 0.390 × 0.390 × 0.340 m³ = 51.71 L. $1,049 / 51.71 L = $20.29/L. Where it loses: it costs $150 more than the K2 Plus and $350 more than the Kobra S1 Max, for 8.8 L more.

findings.note: storecheck.py. The store text states 320×320×300 mm and 65 °C active chamber heating. ChatGPT's card showed $749 at Best Buy.
